sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''The Riderless Chariot: Unstoppable Force''' can use his '''Taxi''' power alongside the '''Teamwork''' power of [[TCG:SAS-060|Hoplite: Lionhearted]] to make it stronger for each minor hero in the Riderless Chariot's [[TCG:zone|zone]]. If you use [[TCG:SAS-110|Hyperstride]] or cards that can make the Riderless Chariot [[TCG:unblockable|unblockable]], you can get an army of heroes deep into enemy lines.

== Playing Strategies ==
The Riderless Chariot: Unstoppable Force can use his Taxi power alongside the Teamwork power of Hoplite: Lionhearted to make it stronger for each minor hero in the Riderless Chariot's zone. If you use Hyperstride or cards that can make the Riderless Chariot unblockable, you can get an army of heroes deep into enemy lines.
